sourceType: Unreal open-world LandscapeHeightfieldCollisionComponent final full-resolution physics heights (uint16), read directly from saved actor bulk data
assembly: 127x127 row-major USHORT height samples per 126x126-quad LandscapeHeightfieldCollisionComponent; placed using its SectionBaseX and Y. Full 4033-square coverage. All shared-edge heights agree exactly.
worldToImageUV: u=(worldX+201600)/403200; v=(worldY+201600)/403200; no crop, rotation or mirror.
derivation: Elevation tints, shaded relief and engraved contours are based directly on the assembled landscape heights. Trees and buildings are illustrative glyphs tied to project survey positions; road/water forms use the project environment data. Color is illustrative, not a biome or ocean classification.
sourceExportLimit: The separately saved 4033 x 4033 heightmap.exr has a constant zero red channel and was not used. The OpenWorld.png captures only loaded geometry and is cloud-obscured; it was not used.
